collection.title: Microcar M-Go 2009 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Microcar M-Go 2009 Onwards requires a single 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
